article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in Brazil: International outbreak linked to cruise ship raises alarms
article.articleSummary: As of May 7, 2026, Brazil is facing a hantavirus outbreak associated with the MV Hondius cruise ship, resulting in three confirmed deaths among passengers, including two Dutch nationals and a German citizen. The outbreak originated after the ship departed Ushuaia on April 1, with complications arising from approximately 40 passengers disembarking in Santa Helena before the outbreak was identified. In addition to the fatalities, five more cases have been confirmed among the 88 passengers, prompting health authorities to trace contacts and implement enhanced safety measures. A KLM flight attendant in Amsterdam is hospitalized with suspected hantavirus after contact with an infected passenger who died on a flight from Johannesburg. While the U.S. CDC assesses the public risk as extremely low, Argentina has reported 101 hantavirus infections since June 2025, indicating a significant fatality rate. Public health officials emphasize that sustained community spread is unlikely, but vigilance remains crucial due to the outbreak's international implications.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでのハンタウイルス感染症：クルーズ船に関連した国際的アウトブレイクが懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での死亡報告、国際移動による感染拡大、高い致死率を伴う予想外の発生。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはブラジルのみが含まれており、記事サマリーでもブラジル（マラニャン州サンタ・ヘレナ）が主たる発生地域として記述されている。アルゼンチンでの101感染例、オランダ・ドイツ・米国への国際的波及が確認されているが、これらは対象国（CEPR活動対象国）に含まれないため、verified_locationsには含めない。クルーズ船という国際的な移動手段を通じた感染、複数国籍者の感染・死亡、高い致死率（3死亡、5追加確認例）が重大な懸念要因である。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in Indonesia: Government enhances screening and response measures
article.articleSummary: As of May 7, 2026, Indonesia has reported eight suspected hantavirus infections linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship, resulting in three fatalities. The Health Minister, Budi Gunadi Sadikin, is collaborating with the World Health Organization (WHO) to improve case management and early detection strategies. Currently, the outbreak is limited to the cruise ship, with no confirmed cases spreading to Indonesia or other regions. The government is developing rapid screening capabilities, including diagnostic tests and PCR reagents, and reinforcing entry screening protocols to mitigate the risk of imported cases. The WHO has confirmed six cases associated with the cruise, including three deaths, with one patient still in intensive care in South Africa. The first symptomatic passenger, a 70-year-old man, died aboard the ship, while his wife and another British national were evacuated for treatment. This situation highlights the urgent need for vigilant surveillance and rapid response to any new infections.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのハンタウイルス感染：政府が検査・対応措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、死亡例を含む重症例が複数確認されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: イベントはMV Hondius船上で発生したものだが、インドネシア政府が積極的に対応を強化しており、国内流入防止を重視している。現在のところ陸上での確認例はなく、船上に限定されているが、国際的な懸念と監視体制の強化が必要。WHOも確認済みの事例であり、死亡例3件を含む。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Brazil: Intensified vaccination and control measures underway
article.articleSummary: As of the 17th Epidemiological Week of 2026, Brazil has reported 38 suspected dengue cases, with no confirmed or hospitalized cases for chikungunya or Zika. The notifications span 29 municipalities, with Morada Primavera showing the highest incidence. Active control measures against the Aedes aegypti mosquito include public education on eliminating standing water and promoting repellents. Vaccination efforts are particularly focused on children and adolescents aged 10–14, who are at a higher risk for severe dengue. Pernambuco recorded its first dengue-related death of the year, involving a 65-year-old man from Rio de Janeiro, with 14,580 dengue notifications from January 4 to May 2, reflecting a 5% decrease from the previous year, including 2,410 confirmed cases and 208 severe instances. Barretos has reported 156 confirmed dengue cases in 2026, with three hospitalizations, including a 4-year-old child. In Campinas, 26 neighborhoods are under a dengue-related arbovirus alert, prompting increased public health measures to eliminate mosquito breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのデング熱：予防接種と制御措置の強化が進行中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱の継続的な流行を示すシグナルであるが、現時点では前年比で確認患者数が減少しており、重症度や国際的拡大のリスクの詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: ブラジルはデング熱の風土病地域であり、定期的な流行報告は通常の疫学的活動。ただし、29自治体での流行、重症化事例の存在、予防接種キャンペーンの強化といった要素から、WPROスクリーニング基準4つに該当する。IHR基準では重症度の詳細（死亡者1名、重症208例）は公衆衛生への影響を示すが、異常性・予想外性に乏しく、国際的拡大のリスク情報が記事から明確でないため、情報集約待ちとして WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in China: Cruise ship outbreak raises health alerts
article.articleSummary: As of May 7, 2026, a hantavirus outbreak aboard the Hondius cruise ship has resulted in eight suspected cases, with five confirmed and three fatalities. Among the confirmed cases are a Dutch couple, both of whom died during the voyage, and a British man currently in intensive care. Health authorities are monitoring additional passengers, with two symptomatic individuals evacuated to the Netherlands. This incident has prompted increased awareness and rodent control measures in China, where the government has confirmed the availability of hantavirus vaccine stockpiles. Historically, the prevalence of hantavirus in China has been low due to effective control measures, but concerns about potential human-to-human transmission, particularly with the Andes virus strain, have emerged. Globally, over 150,000 cases of hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome are reported annually, with China accounting for more than half. The World Health Organization is closely monitoring the situation, emphasizing hygiene practices and surveillance to mitigate risks.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でのハンタウイルス感染：クルーズ船での集団発生が健康警報を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス集団発生で複数の死亡例があり、IHR基準3つ（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。WHO監視下の事例として優先評価対象。
triage.notes: クルーズ船での国際的な集団発生であり、オランダ国籍患者の死亡、イギリス国籍患者の重症化により複数国に関連。サマリーではハンタウイルスの人人感染懸念、特にアンデス株による可能性に言及されている。WHOが監視中と明記されており、グローバルな公衆衛生上の関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in Philippines: Global outbreaks prompt urgent health response measures
article.articleSummary: As of 2026, the Philippines has reported 196 confirmed hantavirus cases since 2013, with three new cases identified this year. The Chaco region, particularly the Boquerón Department, is the most affected area, accounting for 131 cases. A demographic analysis reveals that 85% of the cases are male, with adults aged 20-39 comprising 62% of the total. The national case fatality rate is currently at 14%. Recent global outbreaks, notably linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship, have heightened concerns, as five of eight suspected cases aboard have been confirmed, resulting in three deaths. Many affected individuals are Filipinos, prompting the World Health Organization to emphasize the need for increased awareness and preventive measures, given that the virus primarily spreads through contact with rodent excreta. The situation remains critical, necessitating ongoing monitoring and response efforts to mitigate further risks.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンのハンタウイルス感染症：世界的流行が緊急の保健対応措置を促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）。ハンタウイルスの多数確定例、死亡例、国際的な船舶関連クラスタ、WHOの言及により、フルRRA実施の対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはフィリピンでのハンタウイルス感染の詳細データ（196例、致命率14%）を提示しており、国際的な船舶関連クラスタ（MV Hondius）への言及も含む。Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドはフィリピンを示しており、サマリー内容と一致。ただしソースURLはパラグアイ（.com.py）ドメインであることに注意。サマリーの主題はフィリピンでの発生であり、フィリピンのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in Brazil: Health authorities implement measures to control outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of May 2, 2026, Brazil is experiencing a significant chikungunya outbreak, particularly in Mato Grosso do Sul, which has reported 10,330 probable cases and 4,342 confirmed cases this year, alongside 14 confirmed deaths. The increase in cases among pregnant women is alarming, with a 25% rise in confirmed cases from 52 to 65 within a week. In Pernambuco, there are 1,742 notified cases, with 89 confirmed. Concurrently, dengue cases in Mato Grosso do Sul have reached 5,186 probable and 731 confirmed, with no fatalities reported. Health authorities are urging the public to seek medical attention for symptoms of both chikungunya and dengue, as vaccination efforts for dengue continue, with over 223,000 doses administered. In Araçatuba, a rapid survey for Aedes aegypti, the mosquito vector for chikungunya, is underway, while Dourados has initiated an emergency cleanup campaign in Indigenous villages to combat the disease. The situation highlights the urgent need for proactive health measures and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのチクングニア：保健当局がアウトブレイク制御対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「国際的拡大リスク」が該当。WPRO基準でも「重症度（死亡例あり、妊婦での感染増加）」「流行しやすさ（蚊媒介、広範な伝播）」「管理可能性（複数州での大規模アウトブレイク）」が該当し、多国籍地域でのシグナル判定基準を満たす。フルRRA進行推奨。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはBrazil全体、São Paulo州、Barretosが列挙されているが、記事サマリーではMato Grosso do Sul州およびPernambuco州が主な流行地として明記されている。また、妊婦における感染者の増加（52→65確認症例、25%増）は公衆衛生上の特別な懸念となる。死亡例（14確認死亡）の存在と複数州での同時蔓延は、IHR基準2つ以上およびWPRO基準複数該当の根拠となる。

article.articleHeadline: Avian Influenza in India: Containment efforts intensify amid ongoing outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of May 7, 2026, Maharashtra's Navapur district is facing a significant outbreak of H5N1 avian influenza, prompting health authorities to cull over 250,000 birds to control the spread. The outbreak, first reported on April 30, has led to the destruction of more than 900,000 eggs and the establishment of a 1-km culling radius and a 3-km containment zone around affected areas. Currently, India has confirmed two human cases, both exhibiting flu-like symptoms, but no sustained human-to-human transmission has been detected. The National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) and Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) are closely monitoring the situation, stressing the importance of hygiene and the safety of fully cooked poultry products. The outbreak has expanded to three additional poultry farms in the Nandurbar district, raising the total number of affected farms to 19. Culling operations are ongoing in approximately 30 villages, with total bird culling expected to exceed 400,000.

triage.headline_ja: インドの鳥インフルエンザ：継続的な流行の中で封じ込め努力が加速
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの複数州での多地点発生、人間感染例2件確認、大規模な殺処分実施、国際的な拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準3つ以上、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。
triage.notes: 2026年5月7日時点でマハラシュトラ州ナワプル地区での重大なH5N1流行。人間感染例2件、鳥の殺処分40万羽超、複数州の19農場が罹患。NCDCおよびICMRが厳密に監視中。人間から人間への継続的伝播はまだ検出されていないが、早期警報システムとして機能する重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza in Brazil: Vaccination efforts hindered by increasing fatalities
article.articleSummary: Influenza-related deaths in Brazil surpassed 105,000 in 2025, with Campinas reporting five fatalities in 2026 among unvaccinated individuals with pre-existing conditions. Since January, 65 cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) linked to influenza have been documented in Campinas, where health authorities noted that 53 of the 2026 fatalities were unvaccinated. Amapá has seen a significant increase in influenza-like syndrome cases, with 2,572 reported from March to April 2026, particularly affecting children. Espírito Santo recorded 1,397 deaths from influenza and pneumonia in 2025, while Rio Grande do Sul declared a public health emergency due to a 533% increase in hospitalizations for severe acute respiratory illness (SARI), primarily caused by Influenza A and RSV. Vaccination rates remain critically low, with only 39.3% of the elderly and 17.0% of children vaccinated, prompting urgent campaigns to boost coverage before the May 30 deadline.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのインフルエンザ：死亡者増加による予防接種努力の阻害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：10万5千死亡以上、異常性：複数州での異常な増加傾向、国際拡大リスク：地域的な医療逼迫）。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・管理可能性で複数基準該当。ブラジルにおける大規模なインフルエンザ危機として対応が必要。
triage.notes: 2025年にインフルエンザ関連死が10万5千人を超え、2026年も複数州で異常な増加（リオグランデドスルで333%の入院増加、アマパで2,572症例）を記録。ワクチン接種率が極度に低い（高齢者39.3%、子ども17.0%）ため、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続的リスクが高い。ブラジルは対象国（GeoNames ID: 3469034）に含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Vietnam: Intensified measures to address ongoing outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of May 2026, Vietnam is experiencing significant rabies outbreaks, particularly in Cà Mau Province and Ho Chi Minh City. Cà Mau has reported its second outbreak this year, initiated by a stray dog attack that led to the death of a 32-year-old woman. In response, local authorities have culled the infected dog, disinfected the area, and launched a vaccination campaign, distributing over 1,100 doses of rabies vaccine for pets. In Ho Chi Minh City, there have been four confirmed rabies-related deaths in 2026, an increase from three during the same period in 2025. The city's CDC emphasizes the critical need for timely medical intervention, as rabies is nearly 100% fatal once symptoms appear. Public education efforts are underway to encourage immediate treatment after animal bites, as many residents delay seeking care. In Dak Lak Province, rabies prevention measures have intensified, with one confirmed death and several suspected cases reported, prompting authorities to urge pet vaccination and prompt medical care following bites.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの狂犬病：進行中の暴発に対応するための強化措置
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで複数地域での狂犬病暴発が報告され、2026年の死亡数が前年同期比増加。狂犬病は症状発現後ほぼ100%致命的であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、IHR基準を満たす。
triage.notes: ベトナムの複数州（カマウ州、ホーチミン市、ダッラク州）で狂犬病暴発が同時進行。2026年ホーチミン市での死亡数が前年同期（3例）から4例に増加。犬による咬傷による人獣共通感染症であり、長期的な曝露リスク（放浪犬）と予防ワクチン接種キャンペーン需要が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Unknown Illness in India
article.articleSummary: Recent disease activity in India has highlighted several outbreaks and health incidents. In Maharashtra, a food poisoning outbreak at a wedding affected 62 guests, with 28 hospitalized and 34 treated as outpatients, but the situation is now under control. In Uttar Pradesh, over a dozen residents experienced symptoms from contaminated water, leading to health interventions. In Kota, two women died from post-operative infections, with four others critically ill due to kidney failure. In Bihar, over 100 students were affected by a midday meal incident, with 115 admitted, though most cases were mild. Additionally, in Kakinada's Konaseema district, 28 individuals fell ill from suspected food poisoning after a wedding, all of whom are reported to be in stable condition. No deaths have been reported in connection with these incidents.

triage.headline_ja: インドにおける原因不明の疾患
triage.triage_reason: 複数州にわたる食中毒及び水汚染による集団発症事例が報告されており、IHR基準において異常性と重症度（入院患者発生）が確認される。社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではマハラシュトラ州（プネ・プルンダル）、ウッタル・プラデーシュ州、ビハール州、カタ、およびアンドラ・プラデーシュ州カキナダなど複数地域での事象を報告。食中毒と水汚染が主要なリスク要因。死亡例なし、現在状況は制御下にある旨記載されているが、複数州での同時多発的な食中毒・水汚染事象は公衆衛生的に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in India: Urgent measures required to address alarming outbreaks
article.articleSummary: From March 24 to May 5, 2026, Delhi's National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP) reported 12,078 tuberculosis (TB) cases, with a positivity rate of 16.8%. Among these, 1,323 were pediatric cases, while adults accounted for 10,755, including 6,360 males and 5,715 females. Extrapulmonary TB was notably high, with 5,073 cases (42%) reported, making Delhi the epicenter with a prevalence rate of 747 cases per 100,000 population. Concurrently, a serious outbreak at a Shimla Nursing College has been confirmed, with 19 female students contracting TB due to overcrowded and unsanitary living conditions. The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) is investigating the situation, highlighting significant lapses in hygiene and management, including poor food and excessive work demands on students. Additionally, the NHRC is probing the death of a 19-year-old female inmate in Jharkhand, part of a troubling trend with five inmate deaths since January 2026, raising critical human rights concerns.

triage.headline_ja: インドの結核：深刻な集団発生に対応するための緊急措置が必要
triage.triage_reason: デリーで12,078件の結核患者が短期間に報告され、高い陽性率（16.8%）、特に院外性結核の高い割合（42%）、シムラの看護学校での集団発生など複数の異常な増加が確認された。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響が認識される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはデリー、シムラ（ヒマチャルプラデシュ州）、ジャルカンド州での結核関連事象を報告している。デリーでの短期間での12,078症例報告、院外性結核の異常に高い割合（通常は20-30%だが42%）、看護学校での集団発生、および受刑者の死亡事例の増加により、複合的な公衆衛生の危機が示唆されている。NHRC調査が進行中であり、政府の関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in India: Cruise ship outbreak raises urgent health alerts
article.articleSummary: A recent outbreak of Hantavirus infections in India has been linked to the cruise ship MV Hondius, where three passengers have died and eight others are infected. Among the 149 individuals aboard, two Indian crew members' health status remains unknown. The ship, currently stranded in the Atlantic, includes passengers from 23 countries, with the Andes strain of Hantavirus identified, which poses a higher mortality risk compared to other strains. Health agencies in India are ramping up monitoring and preventive measures, focusing on sanitation and rodent control to mitigate risks. The World Health Organization has classified Hantavirus as a significant zoonotic threat, emphasizing the need for public awareness and vigilance. Historical cases, such as a 2016 incident involving a 12-year-old boy in Mumbai, highlight the virus's potential severity. As the Hondius heads towards Tenerife, health checks and disinfection protocols will be implemented to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: インドのハンタウイルス感染: クルーズ船の集団感染が緊急衛生警報を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準で4つ該当（重症度・死亡あり、流行リスク・長期曝露、管理難度）、および国際的関心が高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Andes株ハンタウイルスは高い死亡率を示す株であり、船舶での集団感染は対象国外への二次拡大リスクが存在。23カ国の乗客が搭乗し、テネリフェへの移動予定のため、国際的な疫学監視が重要。複数の影響カテゴリ（ヒト、動物、ベクター、環境）が関与している。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in Vietnam: National strategies enhance detection and treatment efforts
article.articleSummary: In 2025, Vietnam reported over 119,000 new tuberculosis (TB) cases, marking a 5% increase from the previous year and the highest number on record. Approximately 40% of infections remain undetected, contributing to ongoing transmission. The country faces around 12,000 TB-related deaths annually and ranks 12th among 30 high-burden nations, with a significant multidrug-resistant TB challenge. Ho Chi Minh City is particularly impacted, with about 20,000 cases each year. To address this public health crisis, Vietnam's National TB Program is implementing comprehensive strategies, including universal screening linked to routine health checkups and enhanced diagnostic capabilities through chest X-ray and Xpert testing. The program operates 45 mobile units and 250 X-ray machines nationwide, aiming for a treatment success rate of 90%, which exceeds the global average. With a goal to eliminate TB by 2030, health officials emphasize the need for improved surveillance and management across healthcare facilities.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムにおける結核：国家戦略が検出と治療の取り組みを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、管理可能性の課題）。ベトナムの結核負担は高く（12番目の高負担国、年12,000死亡）、未検出率40%による継続的な感染リスクがある。国家的対応が進行中であり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 2025年の新規TB症例119,000件は過去最高記録。未検出率40%は継続的な社会内感染リスクを示唆。ベトナム国家結核計画による包括的対応戦略が実施中であり、2030年排除目標が設定されている。WPRO地域における既知の高負担国での重要な動向。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox in Thailand: Public health campaigns emphasize prevention and awareness
article.articleSummary: As of May 3, 2026, Thailand has reported 48 confirmed Mpox cases, primarily among men aged 18 to 39. The majority of these cases are linked to Clade II (43 cases) and Clade Ib (5 cases), with transmission largely occurring through sexual contact, particularly following the Songkran festival. The incubation period for the virus ranges from 5 to 21 days, necessitating ongoing public health vigilance. Authorities are promoting health hygiene practices, including condom use, to mitigate risks related to sexually transmitted infections. Awareness campaigns have been launched, and a dedicated hotline (1422) is available for public inquiries. While no fatalities have been reported, the Ministry of Public Health emphasizes the importance of self-protection and community health, advising individuals to avoid contact with symptomatic persons and to seek medical care if they have been exposed. The Department of Disease Control continues to monitor the situation closely, highlighting the need for contact tracing and public education.

triage.headline_ja: タイのMpox：予防と啓発を強調する公衆衛生キャンペーン
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの確認症例が48件で局限的であり、死亡例がないため重症度は限定的。ただしClade IIが優位で国内伝播が継続中であり、スクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当するため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: タイでMpoxの確認症例が48件報告されている。Clade IIが主流（43件）であり、性的接触による伝播が確認されている。現在のところ死亡例はなく、当局による監視体制と啓発活動が進行中。IHR基準は1つのみ該当だが、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・流行しやすさ・長期曝露の3項目に該当し、政府・公衆衛生当局の関心も高い。国際的拡大の直接的なリスク記述がないため国際支援は必要とされていない。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox Clade I in Thailand: Public health efforts focus on prevention and awareness
article.articleSummary: As of May 3, 2026, Thailand has reported 48 confirmed cases of Mpox, with 43 classified as Clade II and 5 as Clade Ib. The majority of cases involve men aged 18 to 39, primarily linked to sexual transmission following the Songkran festival. The Ministry of Public Health is actively monitoring the outbreak, noting an incubation period of 5 to 21 days, which raises concerns for potential additional cases. Public health authorities are promoting hygiene practices and encouraging condom use to prevent sexually transmitted infections. They advise both locals and tourists to avoid contact with symptomatic individuals. A dedicated hotline (1422) has been established for information and support. While no fatalities have been reported, the situation remains under vigilant observation to control further transmission and ensure public safety. Ongoing public awareness campaigns and readiness of surveillance systems are crucial as authorities work to manage the outbreak effectively.

triage.headline_ja: タイのMpox Clade I：予防と啓発に焦点を当てた公衆衛生努力
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade I/Ibの複数確認例（48例、うち5例がClade Ib）が報告され、性的接触による人人感染が確認されている。IHR基準では異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニングでは異常性・流行しやすさ・継続的曝露が該当する。タイは公式監視下にあり、国際的関心も高まっている。
triage.notes: Mpox Clade Ib（レアクレード）の確認は国際的な懸念を強める。記事サマリーでは死亡例なしと報告されているが、性的接触を介したヒト-ヒト感染が確認されており、人口移動（観光客）を含む継続的曝露リスクが存在する。定期的な監視と情報更新が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox Clade II in Thailand: Public health response to ongoing transmission risks
article.articleSummary: As of May 3, 2026, Thailand has reported 48 confirmed Mpox cases, with 43 classified as Clade II and 5 as Clade Ib. The majority of infections are among men aged 18 to 39, primarily linked to sexual contact following the Songkran festival. The outbreak's incubation period ranges from 5 to 21 days, raising concerns about potential further clusters. Public health officials emphasize self-protection measures, including hygiene practices and condom use, to mitigate the risk of sexually transmitted infections. Awareness campaigns are actively being conducted, and a dedicated hotline (1422) has been established for public inquiries. While no fatalities have been reported, authorities stress the need for ongoing vigilance and education to prevent further spread of the disease. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, myalgia, lymphadenopathy, and rash or vesicular lesions. The situation is under control but requires continuous monitoring and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: タイにおけるMpox Clade II：継続的な感染リスクへの公衆衛生対応
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade IIの局所的な集中ですが、確認症例が限定的（48例）で死亡例がなく、当局が状況をコントロール下にあると評価している。ただし性的接触による感染拡大の潜在性と国際的懸念がある大陸での発生のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 当局が「状況はコントロール下にあるが継続的な監視が必要」と述べており、深刻度は中程度。性的接触を通じた人間-人間感染の可能性があり、祭典後のクラスター化リスクが存在する。IHR基準は1つのみ該当だが、WPRO基準では3つ該当し、公衆衛生対応が実施されている点を踏まえWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome in China: Recent outbreak highlights public health concerns
article.articleSummary: As of May 7, 2026, eight cases of Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS) have been reported among passengers aboard the polar expedition cruise ship Hondius, linked to a hantavirus outbreak. Three fatalities have occurred, prompting evaluation by the World Health Organization. Symptoms include high fever, severe myalgia, and bleeding signs, with transmission primarily through contact with rodent excretions. Despite these cases, China has maintained low prevalence rates of HFRS due to effective control measures, and no significant public health threat has been identified. Annually, HFRS accounts for approximately 150,000 cases worldwide, with China contributing over half. The recent incident underscores the importance of rodent control and hygiene practices to prevent outbreaks. Preventive measures include sanitation, sealing rodent access, and maintaining strong hygiene practices, as there is currently no specific antiviral treatment or approved vaccine for hantavirus infections.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でのハンタウイルス肺症候群：最近のアウトブレイクが公衆衛生上の懸念を浮き彫りに
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（重篤な影響、国際拡大リスク）。極地遠征クルーズ船での8例・3死亡という重症事例、多国籍乗客による国際旅行リスク、WHO評価という国際的関心から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 北極遠征クルーズ船での多国籍乗客による集団発生。WHOによる評価が言及されており、国際的な関心が高い。ハンタウイルスは人口密集船舶環境での伝播リスクが高く、複数国への二次感染の可能性あり。中国の年間HFRS症例数は約75,000例と世界的に重要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Indonesia: Urgent need for vaccination and prevention measures
article.articleSummary: As of May 7, 2026, dengue fever poses a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, particularly in Jakarta, where the five-year average of dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) cases has nearly tripled over the last two decades. The outbreak cycle is now occurring every three years or less, indicating persistent transmission. The Indonesian Pediatric Association (IDAI) has called for urgent vaccination efforts for children and the implementation of environmental control measures, known as 3M Plus. Approximately 75% of reported cases are among individuals aged 5 to 44, with the highest mortality rate (~41%) in children aged 5 to 14. The Ministry of Health reports that dengue transmission occurs year-round, exacerbated by climate change and high populations of Aedes mosquitoes. Effective prevention strategies must integrate vector control, education, and vaccination, as emphasized during World Immunization Week 2026. With no specific cure for dengue, supportive treatment remains essential, highlighting the need for enhanced public health measures and improved vaccine access.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのデング熱：ワクチン接種と予防対策の緊急の必要性
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのデング熱の著しい増加（5年平均がここ20年で3倍近くに増加）、高い死亡率（5～14歳で約41%）、流行サイクルの短縮化により、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常・予想外」「長期曝露」に該当。小児人口を含む広範な影響と管理の困難性から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年5月7日の日付となっているが、参考として処理。インドネシアのデング熱は着実に増加傾向であり、IDAI（小児医学会）による緊急ワクチン接種呼びかけ、気候変動との関連性、アエデス蚊個体数の増加により、WPRO全5基準に該当。対象国内での著しい流行状況として識別される。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in Indonesia: Community initiatives and policy reforms enhance TB control
article.articleSummary: As of May 3, 2026, Indonesia has reported over 241,000 tuberculosis (TB) cases, making it the second-largest contributor to global TB cases after India. The government is working towards achieving an 84% treatment initiation rate, aiming for a national target of 95%. Key initiatives include the Siaga TB Village program, which integrates TB screening with the Free Health Check initiative across 16 ministries, targeting 30% of the 70,000 villages nationwide. In Jepara, 678 TB cases were reported from January 1 to May 4, 2026, with all cases under treatment, supported by 160 trained community health workers. Additionally, housing interventions are being implemented to renovate 2,000 homes in 2026, expanding to 10,000 by 2027, focusing on low-income groups. These reforms aim to improve living conditions and enhance treatment success, which currently stands at 80% of the target of 90%. The focus remains on improving screening, treatment adherence, and addressing environmental factors contributing to TB transmission.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの結核：コミュニティイニシアティブと政策改革がTB対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアは世界第2位の結核患者数（241,000例以上）を報告しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められ、政府主導の対策実施が進行中。IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性）に該当し、地域での大規模スクリーニング・治療プログラムの展開はシグナル識別の価値がある。
triage.notes: インドネシアは結核の世界的な負担国（世界第2位）として認識されており、大規模なコミュニティベースの介入プログラム（シアガTB村プログラム）が展開中。結核は予想可能な疾患であるため異常性は低いが、WPROスクリーニング基準の4項目に該当し、継続的な政府関与と公衆衛生対応が確認される。国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限のリスクは指摘されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in Indonesia: Ongoing outbreaks and public health responses
article.articleSummary: As of May 2026, Indonesia has reported 23 confirmed hantavirus cases, resulting in three fatalities across nine provinces. A recent outbreak on the MV Hondius cruise ship involved five cases of the Andes hantavirus, leading to three deaths, although the World Health Organization has deemed the public health risk low. The majority of recent cases have been linked to the Seoul virus, with a case fatality rate of 13%. In 2025, there was a notable spike with 17 reported cases, while 2024 saw only one case, and five new cases have emerged in 2026. The Health Ministry is enhancing surveillance and public education regarding hantavirus transmission, primarily from rodents. Hantavirus can cause severe diseases such as Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS) and, less commonly, Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS). Preventive measures focus on rodent control and hygiene, as there are no vaccines or specific antiviral treatments available.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアでハンタウイルス感染症：進行中の流行と公衆衛生対応
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでハンタウイルス確定患者23名・死亡3名が報告され、複数州での広がり、死亡率13%の重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性（クルーズ船での集団発症）が示唆されており、IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準4項目該当。国際的な輸送手段（クルーズ船）での発生も渡航・貿易制限リスクを示唆。フルRRA実施推奨。
triage.notes: クルーズ船MV Hondiusでの集団発症はヒト-ヒト感染の可能性を示唆し、国際的拡大リスクを増加させている。2025年の17例から2026年5例への報告継続は流行の持続を示す。WHOが低リスク評価としているが、複数州への地理的広がり、複数ウイルス型（Andes、Seoul）の同時流行、死亡率13%、ワクチン/特異的治療がない点を勘案する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Infection in Brazil: Vaccination efforts prioritized for vulnerable populations
article.articleSummary: Brazil is experiencing a significant increase in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases, particularly among the elderly and children, with 45,228 cases reported in 2026 as of epidemiological week 17. Laboratory tests confirm 42.7% of these cases, with Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) accounting for 24.3% and influenza A for 26.7%. In Mato Grosso do Sul, RSV is a leading cause of hospitalizations in young children. The InfoGripe bulletin highlights a national trend of rising severe acute respiratory infections (SARI), with 51,794 cases reported in 2026, 23.2% attributed to RSV. Health authorities in Rio Grande do Sul have declared a public health emergency due to a 533% increase in influenza-related hospitalizations. Vaccination efforts are being intensified, particularly for vulnerable groups, with approximately 1.6 million individuals vaccinated against influenza, achieving 34% coverage. The Ministry of Health recommends RSV vaccination for pregnant women from 28 weeks gestation to protect newborns, as the influenza vaccination campaign continues through May.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおける呼吸器合胞体ウイルス(RSV)感染症：脆弱な集団を対象とした予防接種努力を優先
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年に45,228件の重症急性呼吸器感染症(SRAG)が報告され、RSVが24.3%を占める重症感染症が多数発生。IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「異常/予想外」に複数該当。政府による公衆衛生緊急事態宣言あり。
triage.notes: 2026年のRSV関連の重症呼吸器感染症が急増し、複数州（マト・グロッソ・ド・スル、リオグランデ・ド・スル、サンパウロ、パラナ州等）に広がっている。リオグランデ・ド・スル州では公衆衛生緊急事態が宣言されており、ワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施中。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 in Brazil: Health crisis worsens with rising respiratory infections
article.articleSummary: In 2025, Brazil faced a significant health crisis with 105,873 deaths attributed to influenza and pneumonia, alongside 2,550 fatalities linked to COVID-19. The state of Espírito Santo reported 1,397 deaths from these respiratory illnesses. The WHO has highlighted the importance of hand hygiene in preventing infections, particularly in healthcare settings where healthcare-associated infections (IRAS) are prevalent. ICU patients are at a 30% risk of complications, exacerbated by invasive devices. Alarmingly, bloodstream infections in Brazilian ICUs have been noted at rates of 3.5 per 1,000 catheter-days in adults and 6.1 in neonates, with ventilator-associated pneumonia rates reaching 9.4 per 1,000 ventilator-days. Despite some improvements, only 52.7% of healthcare facilities have antimicrobial management programs. The Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin reported a national increase in severe acute respiratory infections (SARI), with 51,794 cases in 2026, 8% of which were SARS-CoV-2 positive. The elderly remain particularly vulnerable, with influenza A and COVID-19 as leading causes of mortality.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのCOVID-19：呼吸器感染症の増加により健康危機が悪化
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19を含む呼吸器感染症による多数の死亡者（105,873人）が報告されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常/予想外」に該当。加えてWPRO基準の「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」が複数該当し、国際的な関心の対象となるため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2025年および2026年のデータを含む過去のイベント報告である可能性が高い（配信日2026-05-07）。ただし継続的な呼吸器感染症の流行と院内感染（IRAS）の管理が不十分であることが強調されており、進行中の健康危機として扱われている。Fiocruz InfoGripeの報告による2026年の51,794 SARI症例報告は現在進行型の懸念を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A in Brazil: Vaccination campaigns intensify amid rising respiratory illnesses
article.articleSummary: Brazil is currently facing a significant increase in influenza activity, particularly impacting children and the elderly. From March to April 2026, Amapá's Hospital da Criança e do Adolescente reported 2,572 cases of influenza-like syndrome and 216 severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) cases, marking a 107.3% increase from the previous year. Influenza A was confirmed in 97 cases, with vaccination efforts, including Nirsevimabe for vulnerable children, being crucial in managing the outbreak. In Campo Grande, there is a concerning rise in SRAG cases among the elderly, contrasting with national trends that show higher hospitalizations in children under 2. As of epidemiological week 17, influenza A accounted for 39.2% of positive respiratory virus cases, contributing to a total of 45,228 SRAG cases reported in Brazil this year, with 26.7% confirmed as influenza A. A public health emergency has been declared in Rio Grande do Sul due to a 533% increase in influenza-related hospitalizations, totaling 3,280 respiratory-related hospitalizations this year.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザA：呼吸器疾患の増加に伴いワクチン接種キャンペーンが強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで顕著なインフルエンザA活動の増加が報告されており、前年比107.3%の増加、公衆衛生上の影響が深刻（45,228件のSRAG報告、533%の入院増加）、公式な公衆衛生緊急事態宣言が発令されている。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内の複数地域（アマパ州、サンパウロ州、マラニャン州、パラナ州、セアラ州）およびリオグランデドスル州で公式な公衆衛生緊急事態が宣言されている。脆弱層（子ども、高齢者）への影響が顕著。Nirsevimab等の介入措置が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Thailand: Tourist areas face heightened transmission risks
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is currently impacting several regions in Thailand, particularly in popular tourist destinations such as Phuket, Krabi, and Bangkok. The rainy season has intensified mosquito activity, leading to increased transmission rates of the virus. Health authorities are closely monitoring the situation and advising travelers to take precautions against mosquito bites, including the use of repellents and protective clothing. The risk is compounded by the presence of other mosquito-borne diseases like Zika and Chikungunya in the area. Travelers are encouraged to seek medical advice before visiting these affected regions. Similar outbreaks are also being reported in neighboring countries, including Sri Lanka and Indonesia, as well as in parts of South America, indicating a broader regional concern regarding mosquito-borne illnesses. The German Foreign Office has issued warnings for travelers to tropical destinations, emphasizing the importance of preventive measures and consultation with travel medicine services.

triage.headline_ja: タイのデング熱：観光地域で感染リスク増加
triage.triage_reason: デング熱がタイの複数地域（バンコク、プーケット、クラビを含む観光地）で流行しており、雨季による蚊の活動増加により感染が加速している。国家衛生機関が監視・警告を発令し、国際的な渡航警告も発出されている点から、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準（流行しやすさ・管理可能性）で複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は観光地域（バンコク、プーケット、クラビ）での多地点デング流行を報告。雨季による蚊媒介環境の悪化、隣接国（スリランカ・インドネシア）への拡大懸念、ドイツ外務省による渡航警告発出など、国際的な関心と管理上の課題が複合的に存在する。Bluedot発生地域はタイのみで検証済み。

article.articleHeadline: Measles in Indonesia: Vaccination challenges amid ongoing outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Indonesia is facing significant measles outbreaks, particularly in Jember Regency and North Sumatra. In Jember, 25 confirmed cases have emerged from 107 suspected samples, with health officials urging for improved immunization efforts due to delays caused by reagent shortages. North Sumatra reports 748 suspected cases, including 51 confirmed, with outbreak statuses declared in Medan City, Deli Serdang, and Batubara. The low immunization rates, exacerbated by misinformation and a two-month stockout of the MR vaccine, have led to alarming case counts, with only 7.6% of infants in Medan fully immunized. In response, local health authorities are implementing the PENARI program to enhance mass immunization and training for health workers, while also establishing an Early Warning and Response System to improve surveillance and control the disease's spread.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの麻しん：継続的な感染流行の中でのワクチン接種の課題
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、ワクチン接種率低下による流行易性が高く、多地域での同時流行という特徴を持つ。
triage.notes: 複数の地域（ジェンベル県、北スマトラ州など）での同時多発的な麻しん流行。MRワクチンの2ヶ月間の欠品、試薬不足による検査遅延、ワクチン接種率の低さ（メダン市で7.6%）など、複合的なリスク要因が存在。当局がPENARIプログラムと早期警戒システムで対応中。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1 in India: Enhanced surveillance amid poultry outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of May 7, 2026, India has reported two confirmed human cases of Avian Influenza A H5N1, with no evidence of human-to-human transmission. The Nandurbar district in Maharashtra is facing its third significant outbreak, leading to the culling of over 150,000 chickens in the Navapur area. Authorities have implemented a 1-km culling radius and a 3-km containment zone to control the spread. Symptoms in infected individuals resemble those of influenza, and early antiviral treatment is critical. Public health guidelines recommend avoiding contact with sick birds and ensuring poultry is properly cooked. The National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), and other health agencies are actively monitoring the situation. Globally, since 2003, there have been approximately 939 human cases of H5N1, resulting in 464 deaths, but sustained human transmission remains extremely rare. Experts emphasize the importance of pandemic preparedness and ongoing research in vaccine development.

triage.headline_ja: インドの鳥インフルエンザA型H5N1ヒト感染：家禽アウトブレイク下での強化監視
triage.triage_reason: H5N1のヒト感染2例が確認されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度・流行性・管理可能性）でも複数該当。高病原性感染症のピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: H5N1は高病原性インフルエンザウイルスであり、ヒト感染例の報告は国際的なスクリーニング対象。現在のところヒト-ヒト感染の証拠なしとされているが、Nandurbar地区の第3次アウトブレイク、15万羽以上の鶏の殺処分、強化監視体制の実施から、リスク評価（RRA）進行が必須。WHO等への通知基準を満たしている。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in China: Low transmission risk amid recent cruise ship cases
article.articleSummary: As of May 8, 2026, a hantavirus outbreak linked to the Dutch-flag cruise ship Hondius has reported 8 cases, including 5 confirmed infections and 3 fatalities, all associated with the Andes virus. This strain is known for its potential human-to-human transmission, although it is primarily found in the Americas. In China, hantavirus infections typically result in kidney-related illnesses and are not transmissible between humans, with experts asserting that the risk of human-to-human transmission remains low. The World Health Organization and Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection confirmed that no Hong Kong residents were aboard the cruise ship, and the infections likely occurred prior to boarding due to the ship's itinerary through areas with significant rodent issues. Health authorities emphasize the importance of vigilance and effective rodent control measures, as the immediate public health risk in Hong Kong is considered low.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でのハンタウイルス感染：最近のクルーズ船事例の中での低い感染リスク
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスの確認症例と死亡が報告されているが、記事サマリーではヒト-ヒト感染リスクが低いと明記されており、中国での直接的な流行の可能性は限定的。情報の完全性確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は四川省でのハンタウイルス事例を報道しているが、主な感染はクルーズ船Hondiusに関連し、Andesウイルス（アメリカ系統）による感染報告。中国内の在来型ハンタウイルスとは異なり、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低いと当局が評価。香港での確認例なし。IHR基準は2項目で該当するためPICKUP相当だが、公式なWHO通知や国際的拡大の直接的な懸念が記事に明記されていないため、WATCH段階での続報確認が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Meningoencephalitis in Brazil: Child fatality underscores water safety concerns
article.articleSummary: In Rondônia, Brazil, a nine-year-old child died from Naegleria fowleri, the brain-eating amoeba, after being hospitalized at Hospital Regional de Cacoal. The infection, confirmed on April 10, occurred when contaminated freshwater entered the child's nose, leading to Primary Amoebic Meningoencephalitis (PAM). Symptoms include fever, headache, nausea, and vomiting, with rapid progression to severe neurological damage. Public health authorities stress the importance of avoiding nasal exposure to untreated water in rivers and lakes, recommending treated or boiled water for nasal hygiene. Although the risk of infection is very low, vigilance and preventive measures are crucial. The case highlights the need for increased awareness and safety measures regarding freshwater exposure to prevent similar tragedies.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの髄膜脳炎：子どもの死亡が水の安全性への懸念を浮き彫りに
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの稀な脳食いアメーバ（Naegleria fowleri）による死亡例が報告されており、重症度と異常性は認識できるが、感染リスクは極めて低く、国際的拡大リスクや複数地域での集団発生の兆候は記事からは不明。情報不足のため経過観察段階とする。
triage.notes: Naegleria fowleriによる死亡は確認されたが、単一事例であり集団発生の兆候なし。記事では感染リスクは「very low」と明記されており、ブラジルは対象国（WPRO地域外）である。IHR基準は2つ該当するが、WPRO基準との組み合わせと社会的関心を考慮するとWATCH段階が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Japanese Encephalitis in Vietnam: Urgent public health response to recent fatalities
article.articleSummary: As of May 7, 2026, Thanh Hoa Province in Vietnam has reported three cases of Japanese encephalitis (JE), including one fatality involving a 14-year-old girl who was unvaccinated. The girl exhibited severe symptoms such as high fever, headache, and vomiting, which escalated to altered consciousness and multiorgan failure, resulting in her death on May 6. Laboratory tests confirmed JE, prompting health authorities to implement control measures, including extensive mosquito spraying and a review of vaccination statuses in the area. Investigations revealed environmental risks from nearby ponds, rice fields, and livestock facilities. Public health initiatives now focus on enhancing community awareness, promoting vaccination catch-up to achieve over 95% coverage, and advising on preventive measures such as the use of bed nets and repellents. The situation underscores the critical need for increased vigilance and preventive strategies against JE in northern Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの日本脳炎：最近の死亡事例に対する緊急公衆衛生対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。ワクチン接種率低い未成年者の死亡を含む3症例報告で、蚊媒介感染症の地域的増加傾向を示唆。ベトナムは対象国であり、北部地域での強化監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事では「Thanh Hoa Province」での3症例報告。うち1名（14歳女児）は死亡し、重症度が高い。ワクチン接種状況が地域課題として明示。蚊媒介感染症の季節性と環境リスク（水田・豚舎など）が重要。北ベトナムでのJE流行拡大の初期シグナルとして評価。

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Avian Influenza in India: Surveillance and containment measures in response to outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of May 7, 2026, India is actively monitoring the H5N1 avian influenza outbreak, particularly in Maharashtra's Navapur, where over 150,000 chickens have been culled to prevent further spread. Despite the outbreak, no human cases have been reported, according to Dr. Rajeev Bahl from the ICMR. The disease primarily affects birds, but there is concern for poultry workers and those in close contact with infected birds. Initial symptoms in humans can include fever and respiratory issues, necessitating prompt antiviral treatment. Authorities emphasize hygiene and monitoring, stating that fully cooked poultry products are safe for consumption. Historically, India has recorded only two confirmed human cases of H5N1, with sustained human-to-human transmission remaining extremely rare. Globally, there have been approximately 939 human cases and 464 deaths since 2003. Experts advocate for enhanced emergency preparedness and continued surveillance to mitigate potential risks associated with this highly pathogenic virus.

triage.headline_ja: インドの鳥インフルエンザ人感染：発生に対応した監視と封じ込め対策
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの動物での活動的な流行が確認され、人への感染リスク懸念がある。現時点で確定患者なしだが、監視強化と予防的介入が進行中のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 現在のところ人での確定患者がないため、直ちにPICKUPとはしていないが、高病原性H5N1が家禽集団で活発に循環しており、15万羽超の家禽が殺処分されている。感受性集団（家禽労働者含む）への曝露が続く可能性と流行性の高さから、スクリーニング基準を2つ満たしている。インドは歴史的にH5N1の確定患者が少ないため『異常/予想外』ではないと判定したが、警戒継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus 71 in Vietnam: Public health crisis exacerbated by multiple infectious diseases
article.articleSummary: As of early 2026, Vietnam faces a significant public health crisis with a surge in infectious diseases, including Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) linked to Enterovirus 71 (EV71). Over 25,000 children have been affected by HFMD, with severe cases leading to critical complications such as cytokine storms and multi-organ failure. Concurrently, influenza cases range from 8,500 to 11,000 monthly, and dengue fever has seen nearly 32,000 cases reported from January to March, more than double the previous year. The emergence of meningococcal meningitis and co-infections with COVID-19 complicate the healthcare landscape, with one-third of hospitalized patients experiencing severe outcomes. Public health officials are emphasizing vaccination and hygiene practices to combat the spread of these diseases, particularly as EV71 poses a heightened risk of severe illness in young children.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムにおけるエンテロウイルス71：複数の感染症蔓延により悪化する公衆衛生危機
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な多病原体同時流行、国際的拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準も複数該当。EV71を含む複数感染症による大規模集団感染は重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: ベトナムで2026年初頭に複数感染症（HFMD/EV71、インフルエンザ、デング熱、髄膜炎菌髄膜炎、COVID-19共感染）の同時流行が報告されている。EV71関連HFMDで25,000人以上の小児が罹患、重症例（サイトカインストーム、多臓器不全）報告あり。入院患者の3分の1が重症化。対象国リストに含まれるVietnamであることが確認された。国際的な関心と支援が必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Pneumococcus in Brazil: Health authorities emphasize vaccination and preventive measures
article.articleSummary: In 2023, Brazil has reported 32 confirmed cases of meningitis caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae, resulting in 18 fatalities across 15 municipalities in Mato Grosso, with Cuiabá being the most affected area. Health officials have noted a concerning increase in cases compared to previous years, although they assert there is no outbreak or community transmission. In Minas Gerais, an 11-year-old child recently died from bacterial meningitis, underscoring the disease's rapid progression and high mortality rate. Symptoms include fever, severe headache, and neck stiffness, with survivors facing significant long-term complications. Vaccination efforts are being prioritized for infants and adolescents to prevent further cases. In Várzea Grande, the Municipal Health Department has initiated a virtual information campaign following a confirmed case, targeting local schools and emphasizing the importance of vaccination and hygiene practices. Preventive measures include sanitizing surfaces, ensuring good ventilation, and encouraging medical consultations for close contacts.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの肺炎球菌：保健当局がワクチン接種と予防措置を強調
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国）でStreptococcus pneumoniaeによる髄膜炎32例、死亡18例が報告されており、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常性」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡率56%）、管理可能性（ワクチンキャンペーン実施中）の懸念が認められ、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2023年のデータを参照しているが、配信日時は2026年5月と記載されている。死亡率が56%（18/32）と高く、15市町村に広がっており、ワクチン接種キャンペーン実施中。保健当局は「集団発生なし」と主張しているが、既報事例からの増加が懸念される。肺炎球菌による髄膜炎はヒト-ヒト感染が可能で、長期曝露による追加事例の発生リスク有り。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in India: Intensified efforts amid rising case counts
article.articleSummary: In April 2026, Delhi reported 52 dengue cases, the highest for that month in five years, contributing to a total of 107 cases this year. This marks a significant increase compared to previous years, with only 42 cases in 2025 and 31 in 2024. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) has intensified its anti-mosquito initiatives following unusually heavy rainfall, which reached 30 mm, the highest in 18 years. Over 1.215 million homes have been inspected, with extensive vector-control measures including fogging and the release of larvivorous fish at 231 sites. The MCD's efforts included 121.5 lakh household visits and targeted campaigns at construction sites and schools. Legal actions were taken against 16,261 notices and 856 challans for mosquito breeding. Experts warn that dengue is becoming a year-round concern, particularly affecting children under 15. Preventive measures emphasize eliminating standing water and using repellents to control mosquito populations.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱がインドで流行：症例数増加の中で対策強化
triage.triage_reason: インドの首都デリーでデング熱の4月の症例数が5年間で最高を記録し、年間トレンドも大幅増加。IHR基準2項目（異常性と重症度）該当、WPROスクリーニング基準3項目以上該当。社会的・政治的関心も高く、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはデリーおよびインド全体のデング熱発生を主題としており、Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域（India、Delhi）と一致。4月52例は過去5年最高で、2026年の累積107例は前年同期比で大幅増加（2025年同期42例、2024年同期31例）。異常に多い降水量（18年ぶりの高さ）が蚊の繁殖に寄与している点で環境要因も関与。小児患者（15才未満）が特に影響を受けている報告あり。当局による積極的な媒介蚊対策（100万戸以上の家庭検査、薬剤散布、捕食魚の放流等）が実施中で管理可能性への対応があることが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Vietnam: Challenges in prevention and management strategies
article.articleSummary: Vietnam reported nearly 32,000 dengue cases from January to May 2026, more than double the figures from the previous year. The tropical climate, high humidity, and rapid urbanization are key factors in the ongoing transmission of dengue and other diseases, including hand-foot-mouth disease, which has affected over 25,000 children aged 1-5. Coinfections pose a significant risk, as prior influenza infections can worsen outcomes in dengue and meningococcal disease cases. The overlap of influenza and COVID-19 has led to increased hospitalization rates and concerning mortality. In the Mekong Delta, drought-driven water storage practices are creating potential mosquito breeding sites, exacerbating the dengue risk. Public health messaging emphasizes the cyclical nature of dengue incidence and the need for continuous community measures. Authorities are urged to enhance education on proper water storage, ensure containers are sealed and disinfected, and conduct regular larval control to prevent outbreaks, particularly in vulnerable areas.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのデング熱：予防と管理戦略の課題
triage.triage_reason: 2026年1月～5月にベトナムで約32,000件のデング熱症例が報告され、前年比2倍以上に増加。IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: メコンデルタ地域での干ばつに伴う水の貯蔵習慣によるボウフラ繁殖地の増加、インフルエンザおよびCOVID-19との併発感染による重症化リスク、5歳以下の子どもの手足口病感染も25,000件以上で報告されている。公衆衛生の多層的課題を呈示。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus 71 in Vietnam: Rising cases and severe outcomes among children
article.articleSummary: Vietnam is facing significant challenges with Enterovirus 71, particularly affecting children aged 1-5, with over 25,000 reported cases of hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) attributed to this virus. The first half of 2026 has seen a concerning increase in HFMD cases, compounded by nearly 32,000 dengue cases reported, indicating a complex interplay of viral infections. A recent case at Quảng Ninh Obstetrics and Pediatrics Hospital highlighted the severity of EV71 infections, where a 4-year-old child presented with critical symptoms including high fever, rapid breathing, and cyanosis, leading to a diagnosis of severe HFMD and subsequent cardiogenic shock. Intensive care measures were required, but the child showed improvement after two weeks. Health authorities stress the importance of vaccination and early intervention, urging parents to recognize warning signs such as high fever and irritability to prevent severe outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムにおけるエンテロウイルス71：小児における症例の増加と深刻な転帰
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で4項目該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性）。既に25,000件以上のHFMD症例が報告され、小児死亡や重症化リスクが明らかであり、フルRRA進行を要する。
triage.notes: EV71は小児の重症疾患・死亡の主要原因であり、ベトナムでは既に25,000件超のHFMD症例と32,000件のデング症例の並行流行が報告されている。クアンニン省の重症事例（心原性ショック）は病原体の致病性を示唆。ワクチン接種と早期介入が強調されており、公衆衛生上の関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Listeria in China: Improper food storage raises health concerns
article.articleSummary: In Shenzhen, Guangdong, a 79-year-old man developed purulent meningitis caused by Listeria monocytogenes after consuming improperly stored leftovers, including aged frozen meats and expired dairy products. He exhibited severe symptoms such as high fever, neck stiffness, and confusion, leading to a diagnosis of acute bacterial meningitis. Blood tests confirmed elevated infection markers, and MRI scans revealed bilateral frontal subdural effusions. This case highlights the significant health risks associated with improper food storage practices, as refrigeration does not eliminate pathogens. Medical professionals warn that bacteria like Listeria can survive and multiply in frozen conditions, urging the public to adopt better food safety measures. Recommendations include proper sealing of foods, separating raw and cooked items, maintaining appropriate humidity levels, and regular fridge cleaning to prevent foodborne infections.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のリステリア感染症：不適切な食品保管が健康懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: リステリア菌による髄膜炎の単一症例報告であり、重症度は高いが、国際的拡大リスクや公開衛生影響の広がりは現時点で不明。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 単一症例の報告であり、アウトブレイク・集団発生ではない。リステリア菌は食品媒介性病原体として既知であり、予想外ではあるが流行規模や国際的リスクは不明。記事は食品安全教育に重点を置いている。追加症例の報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera in Democratic Republic of the Congo: Intensified response to ongoing cholera outbreaks
article.articleSummary: In 2025, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) faced its worst cholera outbreak in 25 years, with over 71,200 cases and 2,070 deaths reported. The situation remains critical in 2026, particularly in North Kivu, South Kivu, and Kinshasa, where the World Health Organization (WHO) and the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) have intensified efforts to combat the disease. As of Week 13 of 2026, 1,324 new cases and 64 deaths were documented, resulting in a case fatality rate of 4.8%. The response includes the establishment of water chlorination sites, distribution of WASH kits, and support for Cholera Treatment Units. In Week 17 of 2026, the DRC reported 1,085 suspected cases and 29 deaths across 15 provinces, with a case fatality rate of 2.7%. Notably, the Maindombe Provincial Health Directorate accounted for a significant portion of cases from non-endemic areas. Surveillance efforts continue to monitor and manage the spread of cholera across the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のコレラ：継続的なコレラアウトブレイクへの対応強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、25年ぶりの大規模コレラアウトブレイク（2025年71,200例以上、2,070死亡）が継続。2026年も複数州で活動的で、国際的支援（WHO、FCDO）が実施中。
triage.notes: 2025年に25年ぶりの大規模アウトブレイク（71,200例以上、CFR 2.9%）が発生し、2026年も継続中。North Kivu、South Kivu、Kinshasa、Equateur州など複数地域で活動的。WHOとFCDOによる統合対応（水道水塩素化、WASH配布、治療ユニット支援）が進行中。週単位の症例報告により継続的なサーベイランスが確認される。DRC（対象国リスト：203312）のみverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome in Indonesia: Emerging zoonotic threats and public health responses
article.articleSummary: As of mid-2025, Indonesia has reported eight confirmed cases of Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS), with no evidence of human-to-human transmission. The cases are distributed across regions including Jogja, West Java, East Nusa Tenggara, and North Sulawesi. The disease, caused by hantaviruses primarily transmitted from rats, poses significant health risks, with mortality rates for HFRS reaching up to 6% depending on severity. Recent incidents aboard the MV Hondius cruise ship highlighted the zoonotic nature of hantaviruses, with five confirmed cases and three fatalities linked to the Andes hantavirus. The World Health Organization has assessed the public health risk as low, but emphasizes the need for vigilance as further cases may arise. Current management strategies focus on supportive care, including oxygen therapy and dialysis for severe cases, while prevention efforts stress rodent control and hygiene practices to mitigate exposure risks.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアにおける腎症候性出血熱：新興人獣共通感染症の脅威と公衆衛生対応
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでの確認された感染症事例（8例）、複数地域への分散、WHO低リスク評価でも継続監視が必要とされ、人獣共通感染症としての潜在的国際拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月8日配信だが、データは「mid-2025」時点の情報を参照。MV Hondius船上での5例（うち3死）はAndes hantavirusとされているが、インドネシア内陸部8例はHFRSとの区別が必要。WHOが低リスク評価していても、人獣共通感染症かつ地理的分散がみられるため継続的監視対象。齧歯動物からの伝播が主であり、ヒト-ヒト感染なしと記載。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in India: Intensive screening reveals alarming case numbers
article.articleSummary: From March 24 to May 4, 2026, Delhi's TB screening campaign detected over 12,000 cases, including 1,323 pediatric cases, as part of the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan 2.0 initiative. The campaign utilized handheld X-ray technology and screened 71,603 individuals across 224 camps in high-risk areas. In Indore, 3,004 new TB cases were reported from January 1 to April 30, 2026, resulting in 28 deaths. The majority of cases in Indore were adults, with 2,785 cases identified, and deaths primarily linked to treatment non-adherence. Over the past five years, Indore has seen 46,123 TB and MDR-TB patients, with 1,218 deaths. Authorities emphasize the importance of early diagnosis, adherence to treatment, and reducing stigma to combat TB effectively.

triage.headline_ja: インドの結核: 集中的スクリーニングが警戒すべき患者数を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、IHR基準は2つ未満（異常性・国際的拡大リスク低い）。ただしスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡例28件、過去5年で1,218死亡）と管理可能性（当局の対応継続）が該当し、情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: インドでは結核が既知の風土病であり、TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan 2.0などの政府主導の対策が実施中。今回の記事は集中的スクリーニングキャンペーンによる症例検出報告であり、新規感染症フェーズではなく既存疾患の管理体制の強化を示唆している。死亡例や治療中断の問題が報告されているが、国際的拡大リスクは低い。スクリーニング基準で複数該当するが、IHR基準は該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Avian Influenza in India: Culling operations underway to manage recent outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza has been confirmed in Navapur tehsil, Maharashtra, with positive tests from dead birds at three additional poultry farms. The National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal has verified these infections, leading to immediate culling measures. Over 1.5 lakh birds are set for removal, following the earlier culling of 2.47 lakh birds and the destruction of more than 9 lakh eggs and 28 metric tons of poultry feed across nine farms. The affected farms are within a three-kilometre radius of the initial outbreak site. Local poultry associations report significant financial losses, estimating around ₹1 crore per affected farm due to a sharp decline in consumer demand. Navapur, a major egg supply hub in western India, has a history of avian influenza outbreaks, with previous incidents recorded in 2006 and 2021. The current outbreak highlights the ongoing risks to poultry production and local livelihoods in the region.

triage.headline_ja: インドの鳥インフルエンザ：最近のアウトブレイク管理のための殺処分作業が進行中
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの動物での確認イベントであり、複数農場での感染と大規模な殺処分が実施されている。ただし、ヒト感染の報告がなく、公開情報では人獣共通感染リスクの明記がないため、情報不足のため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 動物での鳥インフルエンザ確認事例。複数州（マハラシュトラ、パンジャブ、ウッタル・プラデーシュ）での発生が言及されている。ナワプール地域は過去に2006年と2021年でも発生歴がある。ヒト感染リスク、国際的拡大可能性については記事に明記されていないため、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Marburg Virus Disease in Democratic Republic of the Congo: Global health response intensifies amid rising cases
article.articleSummary: As of October 2023, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is grappling with a resurgence of Marburg Virus Disease, a highly lethal infection with a case fatality rate (CFR) reaching up to 83%. Recent reports indicate a troubling increase in cases, prompting urgent action from health authorities. The DRC has a history of severe outbreaks, particularly between 1998 and 2000, which underscored the virus's deadly nature. Current statistics show three confirmed deaths and ongoing monitoring of the situation as health officials implement containment measures to protect communities. The international community is actively involved, providing essential support and resources to address this public health crisis. The situation remains dynamic, with continuous assessments and updates expected as efforts to manage and mitigate the impact of Marburg Virus Disease progress.

triage.headline_ja: マールブルグウイルス病がコンゴ民主共和国で流行、世界的な保健対応が強化される中、患者数増加に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、マールブルグウイルス病の高い致死率（83%）と症例増加に伴う国際的対応が確認される。フルRRA進行の対象。
triage.notes: マールブルグウイルス病は高い致死率（CFR 83%）と国際的な懸念を伴う重大な公衆衛生危機。国際社会による対応が既に開始されており、3名の確認死亡が報告されている。継続的な監視と追跡が必要。
